_note: THE MEET-UP: a new board family, his idea. The job is turning up; the story is who is there and what they want. Talks at a placed person are built, so most letters need nothing new.
Voices borrowed until his ear casts them. No names, places or currency in any voiced line.
LETTER c: THE WRONG PERSON: her brother is there instead. She got the job she wanted for six years and shipped out this morning, and sent him because she had promised.

FRANCES 2026-10-31 (reviews/2026-10-31-delve-MB93c.md): ship, findings 1-4 and 6 taken, 5 kept. Forced pick answered YES: the letter can be drawn again, so the brother no longer dates her leaving ('this morning' is gone).

place._theme: Any built site where two people could arrange to meet: no caves, no natural landmarks.

prose.name: Recovery: Rhona's Parcel
prose.briefing: A contact called Rhona arranged to meet at the <Place> and hand over a parcel.
prose.card: Private Contract. Meet a contact at the <Place> on <Planet> and collect a parcel from her. Payment on completion.

beats.journal: Rhona wasn't there. Her brother came instead: she'd left for a job she'd wanted for six years. I need to collect the parcel.

person.name: Teo Halden
hellos: I'm not who you're waiting for. Hang on.

greeting: You're here for my sister? She's not coming. She got the job she's been after for six years, and she's gone, and she made me promise somebody would be here.

exchanges.prompt: Then I'll take what she left.
reply: It's just there. She packed it twice.

exchanges.prompt: Six years for one job. She must have wanted it.
reply: Since she was a kid. I'm meant to be pleased, and I am.
Because she said she'd be here, and she's never once not been where she said.

beats.journal: I collected the parcel Rhona left. Her brother came in her place, because she'd made him promise.
beats.name: Rhona's Parcel
